newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy drops on South American weather.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy drops on South American weather.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures dropped sharply this morning on nearly ideal soy crop weather in South America and trader expectations for a slowdown soon in the U.S. soybean export sales pace, traders said.
Soyoil was lower in fast trading, with commission house and local selling hitting that market, they said.
At 0938 CST, soybeans were down 4-1/4 to 9-3/4 cents, with January 9-3/4 lower at $7.03 per bushel.
Soyoil was 0.10 to 0.17 cent lower, with December 0.13 lower at 22.85 cents a lb.
